description: This file is the main entry point of a Flutter application for a simple todo frontend. It sets up the app's theme, main widget, and a basic home page UI with a loading indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: The root widget of the Flutter application, setting up theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the main page of the app, displaying a simple message and loading indicator.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class managing the UI for MyHomePage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, calls runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and MyHomePage, defining app UI.
